title: Orlando's Groundbreaking Transportation
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb:
Most modern vehicles in Orlando, at a price unmatched.

We also have a shade awning for families looking to rest in the shade, or just avoid the rain. It also has a tailgating package for all sports fans. 
Our Mercedes Benz S580 4matic AMG is fully voice-activated.
